hooks.command: bash -c 'cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; FILES=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILES" ]; then echo "[PRE-COMMIT] Validating changed files..."; pre-commit run --files $FILES 2>&1; EXIT=$?; if [ $EXIT -ne 0 ]; then echo ""; echo "[PRE-COMMIT FAILED] Fix the issues above before committing."; exit 1; fi; fi'
